description: This file defines the ReloaderService class, which manages reloading of entities via a list of ReloadService implementations. It provides a method to reload a given entity if applicable.

classes.name: ReloaderService
classes.description: Service class that manages reloading entities of type S that extend AbstractPersistableCustom, by delegating to a list of ReloadService implementations.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the provided entity if any ReloadService can reload it; otherwise, returns the input unchanged.
